facets.label: Reader access
facets.description: What it takes to read the source's articles in full. Distinct from the scholarly registry's access_model (API access).

values.label: Free
values.description: Free to read in full, no account needed.

values.label: Metered
values.description: Some free articles, then a paywall or sign-in.

values.label: Mixed
values.description: Per-article: some posts free, some paid (e.g. a Substack).

facets.label: Voice
facets.description: Who is speaking, which decides how a claim is used.

values.label: Presenters and labels
values.description: Orchestras, ensembles, venues and record labels writing about music they present or record (program notes, liner notes).

values.label: Platform
values.description: A host of many independent writers; authority is each author's.
